original_heading: Fountain of Wisdom and Knowledge, August 1
verse: If any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.—James 1:5
title: Drinking from the Fountain of Wisdom
bullets: True wisdom is found by studying the life of Christ, an inexhaustible subject.
God gives wisdom liberally to all who ask in faith.
Fresh study of Jesus reveals ever deeper treasures for the seeking heart.
prayer: Lord, teach me to seek wisdom at Your feet each morning. Fill my heart with the knowledge of Christ, and let His life shape mine today. Amen.
